name: Bursting Bone Vault
description: This bone-filled vault disgorges its contents the moment the vault door slides open.
disable: DC 20 Thievery (trained) or DC 20 Stealth (trained) to carefully open the vault door without disturbing the bones

generalAbilities.name: Collapse
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature opens the door to the vault

Effect The bones spill from the vault and into the adjacent corridor, dealing (2d10+13) Bludgeoning Damage damage to each creature within 10 feet of the door (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw). The area becomes difficult terrain.
